Deprecated functions

Source: R/tidypptsda-deprecated.R
tidypptsda-deprecated.Rd

These functions were renamed. They still work but give a warning; use the new names instead:

OldNew
import_nedap()read_station()
preprocess_data()prep_visits()
clean_weight_get()clean_weight()
adg_get()clean_weight() + calc_adg()
adfi_get()calc_adfi()
fcr_get()calc_fcr()
adg_plot()plot_adg() + save_plots()
adfi_plot()plot_adfi() + save_plots()

my_break maps to the QC parameter stage_range, quiet = TRUE to verbose = 0, print_details = TRUE to verbose = 2. Other old arguments are ignored with a warning; set them through qc_config().

import_nedap(filepaths, ...)

preprocess_data(
  data,
  station_type = "nedap",
  print_details = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

clean_weight_get(data, my_break, print_details = FALSE, quiet = FALSE, ...)

adg_get(data, my_break, print_details = FALSE, quiet = FALSE, ...)

adfi_get(data, adg_res, station_type = NULL, quiet = FALSE)

fcr_get(adg_res, adfi_res, quiet = FALSE)

adg_plot(
  data,
  responders = NULL,
  locations = NULL,
  save_path = NULL,
  file_prefix = "loc",
  file_suffix = "grow",
  dpi = 300,
  device = "png",
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

adfi_plot(
  data,
  responders = NULL,
  locations = NULL,
  save_path = NULL,
  file_prefix = "loc",
  file_suffix = "adfi",
  dpi = 300,
  device = "png",
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

filepaths, data, adg_res, adfi_res, station_type, my_break, responders, locations, save_path, file_prefix, file_suffix, dpi, device, print_details, quiet, ...

Arguments of the old functions.

Value

The result of the new function.
